MISSION COLD WAKE
SITUATION OPAREA: Southern Kuril approaches. An Okean AGI is moving toward a submarine rendezvous.
MISSION Classify the AGI, then withdraw without firing.
EXECUTION Shadow the AGI to the rendezvous, collect the contact picture, and withdraw without firing.
RULES OF ENGAGEMENT No weapons release. Maintain covert station on the AGI.
FRIENDLY FORCES USS Los Angeles is the flagship and must survive. Companion losses do not end the operation.
SUPPORT No surface or air unit is under player control. Manage weapons and damage for the next patrol.
